guarantees.claim: The prim_intr_hw instance intr_kmac_done is instantiated with Width=1, supporting a single interrupt bit.
intr_kmac_done_o is driven by the intr_o output of the prim_intr_hw instance.
hw2reg.intr_state.kmac_done.de and hw2reg.intr_state.kmac_done.d are driven by the hw2reg_intr_state_de_o and hw2reg_intr_state_d_o outputs of the instance, respectively.

assumptions.claim: event_absorbed must be a single-cycle pulse when an absorption completes. A longer assertion or repeated pulses without clearing may cause missed or stuck interrupt behavior inside prim_intr_hw.
assumptions.risk: Interrupt state may not reflect actual completion, leading to lost or spurious interrupts.

assumptions.claim: reg2hw.intr_test.kmac_done.qe must be a single-cycle strobe synchronous to clk_i when reg2hw.intr_test.kmac_done.q changes. If it stays high for multiple cycles, multiple test writes may occur.
assumptions.cond: when software writes to the interrupt test register
assumptions.risk: Unexpected interrupt assertion or state corruption.

assumptions.claim: The hw2reg infrastructure must sample hw2reg.intr_state.kmac_done.d on cycles where hw2reg.intr_state.kmac_done.de is high to correctly capture interrupt state.
assumptions.risk: Software readback of interrupt state (INTR_STATE.kmac_done) may be stale or incorrect.

assumptions.claim: intr_kmac_done_o is a level interrupt that remains asserted until the interrupt state is cleared via reg2hw.intr_state.kmac_done.q. The external interrupt controller must handle level-sensitive behavior appropriately.
assumptions.cond: when the interrupt is enabled and state is set
assumptions.risk: If treated as edge-triggered, the interrupt may be missed or duplicated.

uncertain_points.claim: If event_absorbed asserts again before software clears the interrupt state, the prim_intr_hw internal behavior is unknown from this chunk—it may overwrite the existing pending state or ignore the new event.
uncertain_points.cond: when a second event occurs before the first interrupt is cleared
uncertain_points.risk: Lost interrupt event or double accounting of an absorption completion.

uncertain_points.claim: The logic generating event_absorbed (not in this chunk) must produce a properly timed pulse. This chunk only connects the signal to the interrupt instance.
uncertain_points.risk: A malformed pulse can cause interrupt misbehavior already covered in A1.
